message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2) in European populations**

| Source | Population subset | Allele frequency (C allele) |
|--------|-------------------|-----------------------------|
| **gnomAD v2.1.1** | Non‑Finnish Europeans (EUR) | **≈ 0.07** (7 %) |
| **1000 Genomes Project** | European (EUR) super‑population | **≈ 0.06–0.08** (6–8 %) |
| **ExAC** | European (EUR) | **≈ 0.07** (7 %) |

> **Interpretation**  
> The rs7412 variant corresponds to the **C allele** at position 112 of the APOE gene, which defines the ε2 allele. In most European cohorts the minor allele frequency (MAF) is around **7 %**, with slight variation among sub‑populations (e.g., slightly higher in Southern Europeans, slightly lower in Northern Europeans).  

> **Why it matters**  
> The ε2 allele is associated with a lower risk of late‑onset Alzheimer’s disease but a higher risk of type II hyperlipoproteinemia. Knowing its frequency helps in population‑based risk assessments and in designing studies that require adequate power to detect associations with this allele.

**Key references**

1. gnomAD browser – https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412  
2. 1000 Genomes Project – https://www.internationalgenome.org/data-portal/  
3. ExAC browser – https://exac.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412  

If you need the frequency for a specific European sub‑group (e.g., Italian, German, Finnish), let me know and I can pull the exact numbers from the relevant dataset.
